dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature (falcate) starting from the mid-point and extending to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; not acute or pointed.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steep, progressive incline approximately 55 degrees relative to the visible dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin height from apex to base is approximately 0.85 times the maximum visible horizontal base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch/tissue loss is visible on the lower section of the trailing edge. Fine linear rake marks and surface abrasions are distributed across the lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multi-stepped indentation on the posterior margin creating a unique jagged profile.
